> 第2356章 水很深（第1页）
冥夜无天在冥间地狱的地位，几乎已经仅次于冥族的几尊神境巨头，享受有最好的资源，最高的修炼待遇，所以修为提升速度，不比牧帆慢。
修炼待遇上，要说比牧帆差一些的，也就只有时空宝塔了。
这种逆天的时间类宝物，天下仅此一件。
冥夜无天的修为境界，也是乾坤永恒境后期，战力比牧帆稍弱一些，不过同样能够跨越境界的鸿沟，和天地永恒境后期的强者交锋，像刚才这种情况下的偷袭，甚至能够威胁到天地永恒境巅峰。
正因为如此，才让洛天神王吃了大亏。
洛天神王受的伤可不轻，他瞬间暴怒，怒吼的同时，一掌拍向了冥夜无天的脑袋。
这一掌，所蕴含的力量，足以轻松拍死普通的乾坤永恒境强者。
冥夜无天相当谨慎，即便洛天神王已经受了重伤，也不与洛天神王硬碰硬，见后者挥掌打来，连忙使出《冥神卷》中的身法神通，迅速拉开身位，躲了过去。
由于速度够快，冥夜无天只是被洛天神王的掌劲所震到了一些，并无大碍。
与此同时，洛天神王已经受了伤，无法继续维持自身的洛水领域世界，这一层洛水领域世界，已经消失。
没有了束缚，牧帆如鱼入大海，又可以尽情的施展时空间力量了！
时间力量，宛如时间天河，笼罩全场。
有了时空力量的辅助，血刀神王三人凛冽的攻势，瞬间受阻。
众所周知，要对付精通时间之道、空间之道、黑暗之道的这种对手，必须得先限制这种手段才行，否则会很不好对付，即便能赢，也根本留不住对方。
而此刻，血刀神王和火凤神皇，一个主修刀道，一个主修火道，都是主进攻的，都不能很好的限制牧帆的时空之道。
至于天煞神皇，修为才天地永恒境初期而已，自然限制不了牧帆。
唯一的洛天神王，其修炼的洛水领域世界，原本可以限制牧帆，可惜此刻已经受了重伤！
凭借时空力量，牧帆很快便从三人的围攻中冲了出来，并瞬间拉开了一定的身位。

牧帆瞥了一眼冥夜无天，后者明显并非路过这里，而是这几天一直跟在后方，凭借了不得的隐匿手段，甚至躲过了他的感知，一直观察着局面，刚才在关键时刻忽然出手。
“难怪这些天总感觉有人在后面跟着我，原来是他……”
牧帆心中吃惊的同时，心中也是倍感意外。
没想到关键时刻出手的人，居然会是冥夜无天。
“牧兄，你答应借我的都还没给呢，可不能死在这些老家伙的手中。”
冥夜无天看起来很轻松，淡然一笑。
牧帆亦是爽朗一笑，“肯定会借！”
血刀神王看了一眼受伤不轻的洛天神王，犀利的眼眸直盯着冥夜无天，声音冰冷无比：“乾坤永恒境的修为，却能有如此实力，听说天下除了牧帆，只有冥间地狱的冥夜无天能做到，所以，你便是冥夜无天？”
冥夜无天直言道：“是我又如何？”
后方的天煞神皇，沉声道：“牧帆小儿，你勾结地狱界神灵，伤我玄元界神王，罪不可恕！”
牧帆闻言，顿时一阵讥讽，“老匹夫，你若是不服，就去天宫那儿告状去！
与地狱界的人合作，这对于你们玄元界而言，早就是家常便饭了吧？”
来自远古生灵一族的火凤神皇，其目光，不停的在牧帆和冥夜无天的身上切换，心中震惊不已。
“看来，当今的宇宙，远比想象中还要强大，水很深……”
洛天神王死死盯着冥夜无天，“小子，不管你是谁，刚刚那一指，本王必会还给你！”

The latest chapter of Supreme God Secret_Chapter 2356 The water is very deep Page 1_Supreme God Secret Li Zhiying_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 2356 The water is deep (page 1)
Ming Ye Wutian's status in the Underworld Hell is almost second only to the several god-level giants of the Nether Clan. He enjoys the best resources and the highest training treatment, so his cultivation speed is no slower than that of Mu Fan.
In terms of training treatment, the only one who is worse than Mu Fan is the Time and Space Pagoda.
There is only one such heaven-defying time treasure in the world.
Ming Ye Wutian's cultivation realm is also in the late stage of the Qiankun Eternal Realm. His combat power is slightly weaker than Mu Fan's, but he can also cross the realm gap and compete with the strong men in the late stage of the Heaven and Earth Eternal Realm. A sneak attack like this just now can even threaten the peak of the Heaven and Earth Eternal Realm.
Because of this, God King Luotian suffered a great loss.
The injury suffered by God King Luotian was not light. He was instantly furious. While roaring, he slapped Ming Ye Wutian on the head with his palm.
The power contained in this palm is enough to kill ordinary Qiankun Eternal Realm experts with ease.
Ming Ye Wutian was very cautious. Even though Luo Tian God King had been seriously injured, he did not confront Luo Tian God King head-on. When he saw the latter striking with his palm, he quickly used the movement skills in the "Underworld Scroll" to quickly pull away and dodge.
Because the speed was fast enough, Ming Ye Wutian was only slightly shocked by the palm power of God King Luotian, and was not seriously injured.
At the same time, Luotian Divine King has been injured and cannot continue to maintain his own Luoshui realm world. This layer of Luoshui realm world has disappeared.
Without the restraints, Mu Fan is like a fish in the sea, and can once again exert the power of time and space to his heart's content!
The power of time, like the Milky Way of Time, enveloped the entire audience.
With the assistance of the power of time and space, the fierce offensive of the three Blood Blade God Kings was instantly blocked.
As we all know, to deal with an opponent who is proficient in the ways of time, space, and darkness, you must first limit this method. Otherwise, it will be very difficult to deal with. Even if you can win, you will not be able to keep the opponent at all.
At this moment, the Blood Knife God King and the Fire Phoenix God Emperor, one majoring in the way of swords and the other majoring in the way of fire, are both mainly offensive, and neither of them can very well restrict Mu Fan's way of time and space.
As for the Tiansha God Emperor, he is only at the early stage of the Eternal Realm of Heaven and Earth, so naturally he cannot restrict Mu Fan.
The only Luotian God King, who cultivated in the Luoshui realm world, could have restricted Mu Fan, but unfortunately he was seriously injured at this moment!
With the power of time and space, Mu Fan quickly rushed out from the siege of the three people and instantly opened up a certain position.
Mu Fan glanced at Ming Ye Wutian. The latter was obviously not passing by, but had been following behind for the past few days. With his incredible concealment method, he even escaped his perception. He had been observing the situation and suddenly took action at the critical moment.
"No wonder I always feel like someone is following me these days. It turns out it's him..."
While Mu Fan was surprised, he was also doubly surprised.
Unexpectedly, the person who took action at the critical moment would be Ming Ye Wutian.
"Brother Mu, you haven't given me what you promised to lend me, but you can't die in the hands of these old guys."
Ming Ye Wutian looked relaxed and smiled lightly.
Mu Fan also smiled heartily, "I will definitely borrow it!"
Blood Knife Divine King glanced at the seriously injured Luotian Divine King, and stared at Ming Ye Wutian with his sharp eyes, his voice was extremely cold: "You are in the eternal realm of Qiankun, but you can have such strength. I heard that except for Mu Fan, only Ming Ye Wutian from Hell in the world can do this, so you are Ming Ye Wutian?"
Ming Ye Wutian said bluntly: "So what if it's me?"
The Tiansha God Emperor behind him said in a deep voice: "Mu Fan, my son, you colluded with the gods of the hell world and hurt me, the God King of the Xuanyuan Realm. This is an unforgivable crime!"
When Mu Fan heard this, he immediately burst into sarcasm, "Old man, if you are not convinced, go to the Tiangong to file a complaint!
Cooperating with people from the hell realm, this is for youAs far as the Xuanyuan world is concerned, it has long been commonplace, right? "
The Fire Phoenix God Emperor, who came from a clan of ancient creatures, kept switching his eyes between Mu Fan and Ming Ye Wutian, and was shocked in his heart.
"It seems that today's universe is far more powerful than imagined, and the water is very deep..."
Luotian God King stared at Ming Ye Wutian, "Boy, no matter who you are, I will definitely return that finger to you just now! "
